newsitem.title: USA: West Agro, Unilever unit swap certain businesses.
newsitem.headline: West Agro, Unilever unit swap certain businesses.

text.p: West Agro Inc and Diversey Lever Inc, a unit of Unilever Plc, said on Friday they have signed a definitive agreement to exchange certain industrial cleaning products businesses.
Terms of the exchange were not disclosed. The companies said the deal is expected to be completed by September 18, 1996.
West Agro is a member of the Tetra Laval Group of Sweden.

The companies said West Agro will acquire the agricultural dairy farm cleaning products business of Diversey Lever while Diversey Lever will acquire the meat plant and poultry plant cleaning products segments of West Agro's food processing business.
No manufacturing locations are involved and only a few employees will be transferred from one company to the other, the companies said.
